_comment: Golden fixture for the discovery ServerSelector — input a `discovery:`-block-body YAML (the selector line, plus optionally another key so the selector can be omitted) -> per-name Selected() verdicts. Read by BOTH the Go runner (cmd/shed-host-agent/golden_test.go:TestGoldenServerSelector, via a real yaml.Unmarshal into DiscoveryConfig + Servers.Selected) and the Rust runner (crates/shed-host-agent/src/config.rs tests::golden_server_selector, via yaml_lite::parse -> DiscoveryConfig::from_node -> ServerSelector::selected). Pins the load-bearing nil-vs-empty distinction: an ABSENT selector selects everything, an EXPLICIT empty list (`servers: []`) selects nothing. Mirrors config_discovery_test.go:TestServerSelectorUnmarshal + TestServerSelectorSelected.

vectors.name: omitted selector (absent servers key) selects everything
single-name scalar becomes a one-element list
